note: Catalog of hooks this repo installs into ~/.claude/settings.json. Placeholders are rendered at install time by scripts/claude-install.mjs. See docs/claude/hooks-catalog.md.

hooks.description: Append one JSONL record per Skill invocation to tmp/logs/skill-audit.jsonl. Passive: never blocks, always exits 0.

Companion to skill-audit. A slash command typed by the user expands before the model sees it, so it never reaches the Skill tool and PreToolUse never fires. This catches those, recorded with invocation=user.
Records every subagent spawn. SubagentStart is used rather than PreToolUse on the Agent tool because it fires however the subagent was started, and carries agent_type directly.
Optional companion to skill-audit. Records skill completion so the analyzer can pair start/finish. Doubles log volume; off by default.

Reject code comments introduced by Edit/Write in known code file types, per the CLAUDE.md no-comments rule. PostToolUse runs after the write, so exit 2 is a correction fed back to Claude rather than a veto. Enabled 2026-09-10; see hooks-catalog.md for the known false positives.
